name: How long does a typical kitchen drywall repair take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen drywall repair take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most kitchen drywall repairs take between one and three days to complete properly. While hanging a replacement patch only takes a short time, taping, applying multiple thin coats of joint compound, and allowing each layer to dry completely before sanding requires patience. If your kitchen requires custom texture matching, like knockdown or orange peel, plus primer and color-matched finish paint, drying cycles extend the overall schedule. Minor screw pops or small anchor holes can often be patched and skimmed faster, whereas large wall cutouts behind sinks or dishwashers require full structural drying intervals before applying final coats.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen drywall repairs take one to three days. The process requires adequate drying time between compound coats, texturing, priming, and interior finish painting.
